suite: the DAG zoom, Fit and the grid header
expect_red: [real] Fit brings the study's whole lit set into the window in one step

mutations.contract: Fit scales the lit set to the DAG region's visible height.
mutations.note: Re-pointed by handoff the_page_is_a_fixed_layout_and_nothing_scrolls_the_document (2026-11-14): the window is the DAG region's own scroller now. Fits against half again the region, so the lit set runs past its foot. Declared with the guard by handoff the_kinematic_study_reads_like_every_other_study_and_its_plot_shows_both_tolerances (2026-10-28). Fits against the viewport's top, so the lit set's top edge lands under the topbar. (Fitting to twice the window left the pointer on an edge and its hover card over the Fit button, which aborted the suite.)
